title: Foebreaker
summary: A +2 maul that bypasses Bludgeoning resistance. A missed melee attack can still deal damage.

fields.Damage: 2d6 + 2 Bludgeoning. Martial, two-handed, heavy, dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Lethal Weapon: Ignore Bludgeoning resistance, but not immunity. The pinned rule reports that other Bludgeoning sources, including eligible unarmed strikes and spells, can also bypass resistance while the maul is equipped.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand. When you miss a melee attack, spend your Reaction to deal Bludgeoning equal to your Strength modifier, minimum 1. Does not apply the missed weapon action’s special effect.
fields.Backbreaker: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make a melee attack against a Large or smaller target for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Bludgeoning. On a hit, a Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Prone for 2 turns.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, a Constitution save against hybrid DC prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed imposes disadvantage on Wisdom saves, removes the Dexterity AC bonus, and blocks reactions that spend the Reaction resource. An ally can end it with Help.
fields.Acquisition: Reveal the invisible chest in the Karsus Vault with See Invisibility or Faerie Fire. Reach the opening lever via Silverhand, Abjuration and Silver, then return through Demon.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
